MSFTx.name: Jellie
MSFTx.story: Jellie is a grey-and-white cat with grey-green eyes and a crooked grin.
MSFTx.why: She follows Jellie, the real grey-and-white cat with grey-green eyes who became a Minecraft cat skin (Microsoft owns Mojang), and now carries Jellie's name. Her owner's 'grumpy smile' became the crooked grin. The game is not named.
MSFTx.src: minecraft.wiki/w/Cat: 'Jellie (gray and white with gray-green eyes)' (notes/MSFTX.md; MSFTX-verify/mc-cat-raw.txt)

GOOGLx.name: Momo the Cat
GOOGLx.story: Momo, a solid black cat with bright yellow eyes, blinks hello from the lantern-lit porch.
GOOGLx.why: She follows Momo the Cat, the recurring black cat in Google's Halloween Doodle games, drawn from Doodle artist Juliana Chen's real black cat Momo with yellow eyes. Only the coat and eye colour are used; no wand, hat or logo.
GOOGLx.src: doodles.google/doodle/halloween-2016 and halloween-2020: 'real-life black cat named Momo'; 'Momo the Cat' (notes/GOOGLX.md)

AMZNx.name: Leo the Lion
AMZNx.story: Leo, a sturdy tawny cat with a mane-like ruff, turns on the old sundial to follow the sun.
AMZNx.why: Big-cat link: he follows Leo the Lion, the MGM lion now used by Amazon MGM Studios, as a plain tawny house cat with a mane-like ruff on his neck. The logo's ring and the roar are left out.

COINx.name: Mister Miggles
COINx.story: Mister Miggles, a fluffy flat-faced grey cat with a grumpy pout, glares at pigeons.
COINx.why: He is the fluffy, flat-faced, grey-taupe cat with a sulky pout from Coinbase's 2024 brand campaign, Mister Miggles, and carries his name.
COINx.src: @coinbase 2024-07-17 and shortyawards.com/17th/mister-miggles: 'a cat named Mister Miggles' (notes/COINX*.md)

BRK.Bx.name: Cam the Cat
BRK.Bx.story: Cam, a white calico, guards the garden pond like a moat.
BRK.Bx.why: She follows Cam the Cat, a Squishmallows plush made by Jazwares, a Berkshire subsidiary: a white calico with one ginger ear, one black ear and one black front leg. She is drawn as a real cat, not a plush.
